items.summary: Overall disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising use where rights or material controls are unresolved; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current public terms point against the proposed public/commercial use. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon results: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, not site-attributable. Exact decision: keep rights-dependent products private and keep external rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach and review the consolidated read-only launch evidence bundle; do not request duplicate telemetry or create new production work.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Existing evidence does not support publication, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue admission. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO at the deadline.
